comment: The difference-register ids the Work's specs propose (verification 01 §9.1: final; a new entry takes the next free number in its area). register:check reports a cited id that is in this list but not yet filed as pending (an error under --strict), and any other unfiled id as an error. Snapshot of the proposal, 2026-10-16.

ids.title: Backend measures/draws "" and unknown families in Noto Sans instead of DejaVu
`\u` escapes in JSON load (C++ failed the load)
Duplicate JSON key: last wins (C++: first)
An integer member written as `2.0` reads as 2 (C++: absent)
Integers not truncated to 32 bits (colours excepted)
Empty text measures as one empty line everywhere
Non-finite numbers written as 0
Object keys escaped on write
Erase batch in store order
Equal-distance alignment snaps: stable, store order
Object-issued clip/save/restore/translate now honoured
Equal `order` ties sorted by id bytes, stable
Six JSON legacy object types converted to templated on load
No attribute update sent for an absent object
`UpdateSession.version` initialised from the board source and reset on load (B2)
A `load` frame with empty `changes` is rejected (B3)
Realtime frames apply transactionally: validate all, then mutate (B4)
Page bounds include the first object's stroke
Queries no longer rewrite auto routes
Deterministic embed/help id collision winner
`LineConnection::getParams` on an empty route returns empty params (B18b)
`getConnections` includes edges attached to a group itself (B18c)
Web PDF is vector (today one 72 dpi JPEG per page)
PDF (and SVG) gradients use all stops
SVG export honours clip, translate and save/restore
The 50 MP / 100 MP raster cap applies on every platform
A hand-off reached in the background waits for `to_foreground` instead of being dropped (Android)
A page whose computed size is below 1 unit is skipped (filed only if AC-EXP-03 golden differs)
Phantom pages from the old empty-board bug are shown as a recovered page
Old clients can no longer download a 5.0 board's content or co-edit a 5.0 board
An unparseable data expression evaluates to 0 with a warning, instead of a null dereference
`libnames.json` is loaded on Android too (search finds not-yet-downloaded shapes)
Generator minimum size starts at 0, not garbage
`ios_picker` no longer keeps a stale selected row
`calendar`/`android_datepicker` with malformed text draw the default date, not an empty/stale shape
Month info is timezone-independent
`android_datepicker` "Web" -> "Wed"
`android_datepicker` header weekday (fixed, OQ-20)
Leaked globals made local (no visible change expected)
Generator failures warn; a first-generation failure shows the placeholder
Templates regenerate once when a late font finishes loading
Unknown native shape or generator type is preserved as a placeholder, not dropped
Wireframe `data` number formatting differs from Lua's `%.14g` (doubles; no float32)
Silent reconnect after background (withdrawn by OQ-58; today's Reload dialog kept)
C1: ShapeColl::takeOut picks max-perimeter final shape (first on ties)
C2: CxPoly::computeBasicFeatures maxx = p.x (was p.y)
Parity differences traced to tie-prone sorts made total (B8)
Borderline discrete flips from doubles instead of float32 / Math.PI (<=0.5% of corpus)
Line pitch is 1.18 x effective font size everywhere, font box centred in each line
`fontmultiplier != 1` now scales the line pitch too on web (today only the glyphs)
CJK/Thai, hyphenated words, URLs and over-long words wrap on web/backend as natively
`fontmodifier` (face suffix) is honoured on every platform, not only iOS
The web text editor uses the object's text colour instead of black
New shapes get `fontfamily: "Noto Sans"`
Unknown or platform-only family draws in Noto Sans instead of platform `sans-serif`/Roboto
Family names are always quoted in font strings (fixes `Bodoni 72`-style invalid fonts)
Paragraph base direction is its first strong character on web and backend too
First of one-per-family entries for Apple families the WKWebView spike (H-TXT-1) finds not rendering
Canvas layers re-size on a DPR change (crisp after monitor change)
Board UI icons are look-alike react-icons glyphs, not the C++ SVGs (OQ-06)
